scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug && cd .. && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk','ClearNine.apk'); console.log('Wrote ClearNine.apk');"
scripts.apk:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease && cd .. && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk','ClearNine-release.apk'); console.log('Wrote ClearNine-release.apk');"
